*Aṭṭhamanaya Vippayuttenasampayuttapadaniddesa* ("Exposition of Terms Associated with What Is Dissociated") constitutes the eighth method (*naya*) of the *Dhātukathā*, the third book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text systematically investigates Abhidhamma categories using the analytical framework of association and dissociation. SuttaCentral records one translation in one modern language [SuttaCentral].
